entry.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
entry.note: Credentials against the AI management system standard the compliance section tracks
entry.audience: AI management system implementers and auditors

covers: Regulatory and ethical considerations around AI implementation
Aligning AI initiatives with an organization's core business objectives
Developing and implementing an AI management system
Evaluating the quality, reliability and performance of AI systems
Ensuring AI solutions meet standards and function as intended
Identifying AI-related risks and applying measures to mitigate them
Establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an AIMS
reading.summary: This is a page for PECB training courses on the ISO/IEC 42001 Artificial Intelligence Management System standard. The standard sets out requirements and guidance for establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an AI management system (AIMS) within an organization, with a framework for ethical AI use covering fairness, transparency, accountability and privacy. The courses are described as building the competencies to plan, develop, implement, maintain and improve an AIMS. A PECB ISO/IEC 42001 certificate is presented as showing a set of abilities listed on the page.
reading.audience: The page is aimed at individuals who want proficiency in artificial intelligence management systems and who want to obtain a PECB ISO/IEC 42001 credential.
